definitions.gloss: joining a company, entering a company
definitions.explanation: The act of becoming an employee of a company; starting work at a company.

examples.japanese: {来年|らいねん}の{四月|しがつ}に{入社|にゅうしゃ}します。
examples.english: I will join the company next April.

examples.japanese: {入社|にゅうしゃ}して{三|さん}{年目|ねんめ}です。
examples.english: This is my third year at the company.

examples.japanese: {入社|にゅうしゃ}{試験|しけん}に{合格|ごうかく}した。
examples.english: I passed the company entrance exam.

notes:
COMPOUND: {入|にゅう} (enter) + {社|しゃ} (company)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {入社|にゅうしゃ}する (to join a company)
- {入社|にゅうしゃ}{式|しき} (company entrance ceremony)
- {入社|にゅうしゃ}{試験|しけん} (company entrance exam)
- {入社|にゅうしゃ}{面接|めんせつ} (job interview)
- {新入社員|しんにゅうしゃいん} (new employee)

ANTONYM: {退社|たいしゃ} (leaving a company, resignation)

In Japan, most new graduates join companies in April, and {入社|にゅうしゃ}{式|しき} (entrance ceremonies) are a significant corporate event.
